title: Approximate tangent vectors are limits of blow-ups of M ∩ N
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and M, N ⊆ ℝ^P with Hⁿ(M ∖ N) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let x ∈ ℝ^P, and let Q be an approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q): dim Q = n, and ∫_{η_{x,λ}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as λ ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ), where η_{x,λ}(y) = λ⁻¹(y − x). Let w ∈ Q and s > 0. Then there is λ₀ > 0 such that for every λ ∈ (0, λ₀) some y ∈ M ∩ N satisfies |λ⁻¹(y − x) − w| < s.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M N : Set (Euclid P)) (x w : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), μHE[n] (M \ N) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → w ∈ Q → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∃ lam₀ : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam < lam₀ → ∃ y ∈ M ∩ N, ‖lam⁻¹ • (y - x) - w‖ < s
